instruction.text: Drag Guy Fawkes to the Tower of London.

feedback.finish: After Guy Fawkes was arrested, he was taken to the Tower of London.

atoms.b: King James I wanted Guy ((++Fawkes Forks)) and the other plotters to be punished for trying to kill him, but he didn’t know all of their names.
Violent, old-fashioned methods of punishment were used to make Fawkes reveal the names of the ((++twelve two)) other men.

instruction.text: Select Guy Fawkes’ signature of confession.
instruction.sound: Select Guy Fawkes’s signature of confession.

feedback.finish: Guy Fawkes, who signed his name as Guido, confessed to his crimes after being tortured and gave the names of the other plotters. The king sentenced all the men to death.

instruction.text: How do you think James I wanted the plotters to be killed?

feedback.finish: King James wanted them to be hung, drawn and quartered, a punishment that involved cutting the criminals into four pieces! This was reserved for the most serious crimes.

instruction.text: Find and select the three spiky poles on the bridge.

feedback.finish: The heads of the plotters were chopped off and put on spikes around London. This was meant to be a way of scaring other people who wanted to rebel against the King.
